raw.description: 自身登场时，根据本场战斗自身的出战次数，依次触发等量的下列效果：|    2回合内自身受到的技能伤害不超过自身最大体力的25%|    2回合内自身造成的攻击伤害提升100%|    2回合内自身抵挡受到的致命一击|    2回合内令对手体力恢复效果减少50%|    2回合内每回合结束吸取对手所有技能1点PP值|    2回合内自身造成的固定伤害、百分比伤害提升30%|若触发次数为6次，则登场时无法触发上述效果|自身体力高于最大体力的1/2时，回合开始时令对手攻击、特攻、速度-1，未触发则重新触发自身的登场效果并解除自身所处的异常状态；自身体力低于最大体力的1/2时，自身所有技能先制+1，攻击技能威力提升100%且造成的攻击伤害为0时吸取对手100%的体力|自身造成的攻击伤害高于300时，吸取对手最大体力的1/3，自身未造成高于300的攻击伤害的回合，战斗阶段结束时自身特攻、速度+1|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 四项魂印歧义均有用户确认与多次真实状态验证；仅真实换宠增加出战次数的表内后续项延期。
review.singleBehavior: 首次在场授2回25%整次技能红伤上限；高体弱化失败不限重授次数并清异常；低体攻击零红含MISS/失明/整招无效，按对手最大体力百分比理论吸取；控制未用排除。完整红高于300吸最大体力三分之一，未高红战阶强化。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实换宠后第2至5次出战依次授予表内等量项，第6项数不授予；当前首次出战及其任意次数重触已实现。
review.trigger: 来源明确“根据本场战斗自身的出战次数”需真实下场并再次出场增加实际次数；高体弱化失败重触不增加真实出战次数。

success.name: 4903真实2090首次出战只授第一项两回25%红伤上限，固定50不受限且第三回实际到期
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090首次出战只授第一项两回25%红伤上限，固定50不受限且第三回实际到期',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{spd:1},bStats:{spa:9999},loadout:[20155,14102,20082,29352,38393]});turn(s,20155,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),2250);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,2200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,2);turn(s,20155,20117);turn(s,20155,10716);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>2250);});

success.name: 4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常',()=>{for(const mode of['success','partial','immune']){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;if(mode==='partial'){s.fighters[1].stages.atk=-6;s.fighters[1].stages.spa=-6;}if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,mode==='immune'?2:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],mode!=='immune');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,mode==='immune'?0:-1);}});

success.name: 4903真实2090弱化失败重触八次仍保持真实出战一次并刷新第一项
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090弱化失败重触八次仍保持真实出战一次并刷新第一项',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');for(let r=1;r<=8;r++){turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,r+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,r+1);}});

success.name: 4903真实2090严格低于半体才技能先制1与威力加100%，等于半体不弱化也不加先制或威力
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090严格低于半体才技能先制1与威力加100%，等于半体不弱化也不加先制或威力',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500,4501]){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp});let power;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)power=c.power;},()=>turn(s,14102,null));assert.equal(power,hp<4500?100:50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,hp<4500?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,hp>4500?-1:0);}});

success.name: 4903真实2090严格高于300完整红伤才理论吸取3000，300不吸且回末特攻速度各一；临终过量红也按完整伤害判断
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090严格高于300完整红伤才理论吸取3000，300不吸且回末特攻速度各一；临终过量红也按完整伤害判断',()=>{for(const red of[300,301]){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0){c.minimumDamage=red;c.minimumAfterReductions=true;}},()=>turn(s,14102,null));assert.equal(sum(s),red);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),red>300?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,red>300?4000:1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,red>300?0:1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,red>300?0:1);}const a=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1,aStats:{atk:9999}});turn(a,14102,20117);assert.ok(sum(a)>300);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,4000);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,0);});

success.name: 4903真实2090已命中零红按敌最大体力吸取，免粉仍理论回复且技能命中封锁不封魂印
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090已命中零红按敌最大体力吸取，免粉仍理论回复且技能命中封锁不封魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','pinkimmune','sealed','injured']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='injured'?1000:9000});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='pinkimmune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='sealed')timer(s,0,'攻击技能命中效果失效');turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='pinkimmune'?0:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}});

success.name: 4903真实2090实际攻击MISS或整招无效低体按最大体力吸取，控制未用不触发
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际攻击MISS或整招无效低体按最大体力吸取，控制未用不触发',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='control'?0:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='control'?1000:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);}});

success.name: 4903真实2090同回合额外完整技能重新享有25%上限且固定50另算
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090同回合额外完整技能重新享有25%上限且固定50另算',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{def:high?1:300,spd:high?1:300},bStats:{atk:high?9999:180,spa:high?9999:180}}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.m.id===key(10716))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));return r;}};try{turn(s,20155,10716);const hits=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1);assert.equal(hits.length,2);if(high)assert.ok(hits.every(e=>e.settledDamage===2250));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,Math.max(0,4500-sum(s,'attack',1)-50));}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}}});

success.name: 4903已答表内项数：首次出战高体弱化失败九次重授第一项不因重触第六次停止，真实回血维持高体并清异常，表内六项不授
success.assertion: const s=make({move:24170,soul:true,aStats:{def:1,spd:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});timer(s,1,'免弱');for(let r=1;r<=8;r++){s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=s.round+1;if(r===5)Object.assign(s,E.resolveTurn(s,['potion:pp',key(20117)]));else turn(s,24170,10127);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903;assert.equal(st.entries,1);assert.equal(st.entryTriggers,r+1);assert.equal(st.capUntil,r+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),r===5?0:2250);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>4500);}let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){const st=c.a.soulState.emperor4903,until=st.capUntil;st.entries=6;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2090].abilities.entry(c),false);assert.equal(st.capUntil,until);st.entries=1;checked=true;}},()=>turn(s,24170,20117));assert.equal(checked,true);

success.name: 4903已答25%整次技能：多段共2250、额外技能各2250，非红不计额度，属性技能红同次共额，魂印红不误限
4903已答低体零红：实际MISS/失明/整招无效及命中零红均按敌最大体力理论吸取，未用攻排除，正红不冒触零红
success.assertion: for(const mode of['miss','blind','invalid','immune','immune-percent','control','positive']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:3000,hit:!['miss','blind'].includes(mode),aStats:{atk:1}});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='blind')s.fighters[0].ailments['失明']=2;if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(['immune','immune-percent'].includes(mode))timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='immune-percent')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,14102,20117);const events=s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.events.filter(e=>e.event==='low-zero-drain');if(['control','positive'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(events.length,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);}else{assert.equal(events.length,1);assert.equal(events[0].requested,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune-percent'?0:9000);}}

success.name: 4903已答属性红公共通道：同一次属性技能结算的两个红伤输入共用2250额度，完整伤害与实际HP减少分别记录
success.assertion: const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true}),engine=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let fired=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...engine,run(phase,ops,c){const out=engine.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,1500,'技能上下文属性红第一段','attack');c.hurt(c.t,1500,'技能上下文属性红第二段','attack');fired=true;}return out;}};try{turn(s,20155,20117);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=engine;}assert.equal(fired,true);const hits=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1);assert.deepEqual(hits.map(e=>e.settledDamage),[1500,750]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,6750);

interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际攻击MISS或整招无效低体按最大体力吸取，控制未用不触发',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='control'?0:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='control'?1000:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);}});

interaction.name: 4903真实2090同回合额外完整技能重新享有25%上限且固定50另算
interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090同回合额外完整技能重新享有25%上限且固定50另算',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{def:high?1:300,spd:high?1:300},bStats:{atk:high?9999:180,spa:high?9999:180}}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.m.id===key(10716))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));return r;}};try{turn(s,20155,10716);const hits=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1);assert.equal(hits.length,2);if(high)assert.ok(hits.every(e=>e.settledDamage===2250));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,Math.max(0,4500-sum(s,'attack',1)-50));}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}}});

interaction.name: 4903已答表内项数：首次出战高体弱化失败九次重授第一项不因重触第六次停止，真实回血维持高体并清异常，表内六项不授
interaction.assertion: const s=make({move:24170,soul:true,aStats:{def:1,spd:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});timer(s,1,'免弱');for(let r=1;r<=8;r++){s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=s.round+1;if(r===5)Object.assign(s,E.resolveTurn(s,['potion:pp',key(20117)]));else turn(s,24170,10127);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903;assert.equal(st.entries,1);assert.equal(st.entryTriggers,r+1);assert.equal(st.capUntil,r+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),r===5?0:2250);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>4500);}let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){const st=c.a.soulState.emperor4903,until=st.capUntil;st.entries=6;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2090].abilities.entry(c),false);assert.equal(st.capUntil,until);st.entries=1;checked=true;}},()=>turn(s,24170,20117));assert.equal(checked,true);

interaction.name: 4903已答25%整次技能：多段共2250、额外技能各2250，非红不计额度，属性技能红同次共额，魂印红不误限
4903已答低体零红：实际MISS/失明/整招无效及命中零红均按敌最大体力理论吸取，未用攻排除，正红不冒触零红
interaction.assertion: for(const mode of['miss','blind','invalid','immune','immune-percent','control','positive']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:3000,hit:!['miss','blind'].includes(mode),aStats:{atk:1}});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='blind')s.fighters[0].ailments['失明']=2;if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(['immune','immune-percent'].includes(mode))timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='immune-percent')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,14102,20117);const events=s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.events.filter(e=>e.event==='low-zero-drain');if(['control','positive'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(events.length,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);}else{assert.equal(events.length,1);assert.equal(events[0].requested,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune-percent'?0:9000);}}

interaction.name: 4903已答属性红公共通道：同一次属性技能结算的两个红伤输入共用2250额度，完整伤害与实际HP减少分别记录
interaction.assertion: const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true}),engine=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let fired=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...engine,run(phase,ops,c){const out=engine.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,1500,'技能上下文属性红第一段','attack');c.hurt(c.t,1500,'技能上下文属性红第二段','attack');fired=true;}return out;}};try{turn(s,20155,20117);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=engine;}assert.equal(fired,true);const hits=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1);assert.deepEqual(hits.map(e=>e.settledDamage),[1500,750]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,6750);

success.assertion: test('4903/176明确六异常池50%成功失败均真实，716敌实际用攻击才随机两槽PP归零且PP保护阻挡',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:24169,index:2,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,24169,null);const keys=Object.keys(s.fighters[1].ailments);seen.add(keys[0]??'none');assert.ok(keys.length<=1);if(keys.length)assert.ok(['烧伤','冻伤','中毒','麻痹','害怕','睡眠'].includes(keys[0]));}assert.ok(seen.has('none'));assert.equal(seen.size,7);for(const mode of['attack','status','control','immune','miss']){const s=make({move:24169,index:3});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'PP保护');if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'攻击必失');}turn(s,24169,mode==='status'?20117:10127);const zeros=s.fighters[1].moves.filter(k=>s.fighters[1].pp[k]===0).length;assert.equal(zeros,mode==='attack'||mode==='miss'?2:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4903/1959清回合臣服成功不翻红，免异或保护失败红翻倍；699当前新先手技真实无视攻击免疫',()=>{const modifiers=[];for(const mode of['success','immune','protect']){const s=make({move:38391,index:1});if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='protect')timer(s,1,'protect');const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let modifier;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)modifier=c.modifier;return r;}};try{turn(s,38391,null);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}modifiers.push(modifier);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['臣服'],mode==='success');}assert.equal(modifiers[1],modifiers[0]*2);assert.equal(modifiers[2],modifiers[0]*2);const a=make({move:38391,index:0});timer(a,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(a,38391,null);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);});

success.assertion: test('4903/1348敌属性实际抽两种公共PVP异常不含山神守护，全免失败清回合；非属性不触发该监听',()=>{for(const mode of['success','immune','attack','control']){const s=make({move:26555,index:1});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;timer(s,1,'doubleDamage');if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=2;turn(s,26555,mode==='attack'?10127:20117);const draws=(s.randomStatusEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.effectId===1348);if(mode==='attack'||mode==='control'){assert.equal(draws.length,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].effects.doubleDamage);}else{const sampled=draws.filter(e=>e.type==='draw');assert.equal(sampled.length,2);assert.equal(new Set(sampled.map(x=>x.name)).size,2);assert.ok(sampled.every(e=>e.duration===2||e.duration===3));const pool=require('../dist/status-pools.js').configuration(1348).candidates;assert.equal(pool.some(x=>x.name==='山神守护'),false);assert.ok(pool.some(x=>x.name==='束缚'));if(mode==='immune'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.doubleDamage,undefined);assert.equal(Object.keys(s.fighters[1].ailments).length,0);}else assert.equal(Object.keys(s.fighters[1].ailments).length,2);}}});

success.assertion: test('4903/1959清回合臣服成功不翻红，免异或保护失败红翻倍；699当前新先手技真实无视攻击免疫',()=>{const modifiers=[];for(const mode of['success','immune','protect']){const s=make({move:38391,index:1});if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='protect')timer(s,1,'protect');const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let modifier;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)modifier=c.modifier;return r;}};try{turn(s,38391,null);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}modifiers.push(modifier);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['臣服'],mode==='success');}assert.equal(modifiers[1],modifiers[0]*2);assert.equal(modifiers[2],modifiers[0]*2);const a=make({move:38391,index:0});timer(a,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(a,38391,null);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);});

success.name: 4903/2476正常第五PP差1真实先制1，限定六异常独立等概率抽1且仅1回合，2477同招吸取60
success.assertion: test('4903/2476正常第五PP差1真实先制1，限定六异常独立等概率抽1且仅1回合，2477同招吸取60',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:29351,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0,hp:1000});let active;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0)active={...c.t.ailments};},()=>turn(s,29351,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.equal(Object.keys(active).length,1);const [name,end]=Object.entries(active)[0];seen.add(name);assert.equal(end,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments[name],undefined);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),60);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1060);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),['烧伤','冻伤','中毒','麻痹','害怕','睡眠'].sort());});

success.name: 4903/2476第五PP差2无放回抽两种，排序后PP变化在命中重算
success.assertion: test('4903/2476第五PP差2无放回抽两种，排序后PP变化在命中重算',()=>{const a=make({move:29351});a.fighters[1].pp[key(37911)]=4;let priority;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='orderResolved'&&c.a.side===0)priority=c.a.soulState.resolvedPriority.value;},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(priority,2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.draws2476.at(-1).count,2);assert.equal(new Set(a.fighters[0].soulState.draws2476.at(-1).draws.map(d=>d.name)).size,2);const b=make({move:29351});timer(b,1,'id984',{amount:3});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.absorbPP(c.a,c.t,1);},()=>turn(b));assert.equal(b.fighters[0].pp[key(38393)],5);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].soulState.draws2476.at(-1).count,0);});

success.name: 4903已答2476：命中重算第五PP差、合并无放回限定六池且1回合，免疫不补抽，任一失败即时清回合不反算先制
success.assertion: const pool=['烧伤','冻伤','中毒','麻痹','害怕','睡眠'];for(const mode of['normal','count-immune','timed-immune','protected','changed']){const s=make({move:29351,index:1});s.fighters[0].pp[key(38393)]=6;s.fighters[1].pp[key(37911)]=3;if(mode==='count-immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(['timed-immune','protected'].includes(mode))timer(s,1,'免异常');if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'protect');let actual;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0&&mode==='changed')c.t.pp[key(37911)]=5;if(e==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0){actual=c.a.soulState.draws2476.at(-1);for(const draw of actual.draws)if(draw.applied)assert.equal(c.t.ailments[draw.name],c.round);}},()=>turn(s,29351,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,3);assert.equal(actual.count,mode==='changed'?1:3);assert.equal(new Set(actual.draws.map(e=>e.name)).size,actual.count);assert.ok(actual.draws.every(e=>pool.includes(e.name)&&e.duration===1));if(mode==='count-immune')assert.equal(actual.draws.filter(e=>!e.applied).length,1);if(mode==='timed-immune'){assert.equal(actual.draws[0].applied,false);assert.equal(actual.draws[0].cleared,true);assert.ok(actual.draws.slice(1).every(e=>e.applied));}if(mode==='protected')assert.ok(actual.draws.every(e=>!e.applied&&!e.cleared));}

instance.description: 反转对手能力提升状态，反转成功则自身附加相同的能力提升，反转失败则消除对手能力提升状态

raw.description: 若自身处于能力下降状态则技能先制+3；自身每有1级能力下降状态吸取对手60点体力，对手处于能力提升状态时效果翻倍；攻击时将对手的能力提升状态视为相应的能力下降状态；解除自身能力下降状态，若解除成功则3回合内免疫能力下降状态；反转对手能力提升状态，反转成功则自身附加相同的能力提升，反转失败则消除对手能力提升状态

metadata.template: 反转对手能力提升状态，反转成功则自身附加相同的能力提升，反转失败则消除对手能力提升状态

review.rationale: 1767投影范围按用户Q009明确，独立效果原分支保留。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 1061读取投影后的等级，投影负强不视为可反转正强；独立效果按真实等级反转并附自身。

success.name: 4903/881负等级先制3，1767投影正强为负使2171不翻倍且1061不改真实正等级
success.assertion: test('4903/881负等级先制3，1767投影正强为负使2171不翻倍且1061不改真实正等级',()=>{for(const boost of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38393,hp:1000});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;if(boost)s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(s,38393,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,3);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),120);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].effects['免弱']);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,boost?2:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,0);}});

success.name: 4903/1767单独正强视负改变实际红伤而不改原等级，1061独立反转成功附同等强化、免弱时失败清强
success.assertion: test('4903/1767单独正强视负改变实际红伤而不改原等级，1061独立反转成功附同等强化、免弱时失败清强',()=>{const a=make({move:38393,index:2}),b=make({move:38393,index:-1});a.fighters[1].stages.def=2;b.fighters[1].stages.def=-2;turn(a,38393,null);turn(b,38393,null);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,2);for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38393,index:4});s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(immune)timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s,38393,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,immune?0:-2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,immune?0:2);}});

success.name: 4903已答1767：2171和1061均读取投影负等级不再双吸或反转，真实对手正等级保留，速度也按投影负级参与顺序
success.assertion:
const s=make({move:38393,hp:1000,aStats:{spa:10}});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;s.fighters[1].stages.def=3;s.fighters[1].stages.spd=3;turn(s,38393,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),120);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1120);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spd,3);
 const speed=make({move:38393,aStats:{spe:300,spa:10},bStats:{spe:200}});speed.fighters[1].stages.spe=3;turn(speed,38393,20117);assert.equal(speed.turns[0].first,0);assert.equal(speed.fighters[1].stages.spe,3);assert.ok(speed.turns[0].events.some(e=>e.text.includes('速度 300 / 80')));
